text:
cheng: Hey team — need nsys + torch.profiler traces for the latency regression on commit f2a8c3. Can folks upload nsys (.qdrep/.nsys-rep) and torchprof tar.gz to the profiling bucket and drop links here? Please include the cmdline and env.

cheng: Example nsys command to run (feel free to tweak flags):
```bash
nsys profile -o /tmp/trace -f true \n  --sample=cpu --capture-range=nvtx --trace=cuda,osrt \n  python run_repro.py --model gpt-small --batch 1
```

maria: On it. running a couple of runs with batch sizes 1/8. Will upload raw traces + flamegraphs. ETA ~15m

alex: Thanks — when you upload, please name files like `nsys_f2a8c3_maria_1768943210.qdrep` and `torchprof_f2a8c3_maria.tar.gz`. Also include a short text file with `python --version`, `torch.__version__`, `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, and `commit`

sam: For diffing I'll use our flame-diff tool. If you can also export folded stacks (flameprof format):
`python -m flameprof --folded trace.json > folded.txt`

natalie: Quick Q — any sensitive prompt data in these runs? Do we need to scrub inputs before upload?

cheng: Good call @natalie — we used synthetic prompts from the repro harness. If you used any real inputs, redact them. Also gzip the torchprof tarball to save space.

maria: Uploaded to s3://redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/1768943210/ — files: `nsys_maria_f2a8c3.qdrep` (1.2G), `torchprof_maria.tar.gz` (120M), `env.txt`, `cmdline.txt`. Link: https://s3.redwood.internal/redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/1768943210/

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/1768943210/nsys_maria_f2a8c3.qdrep (checksum: sha256:abcd1234)

alex: grabbing and converting to `.nsys-rep` -> flamegraph now. I'll post a differential flamegraph vs baseline by EOD. Quick checklist for uploads: 1) reproduce with `--seed 42`, 2) attach `--trace-kv` or enable kv-cache tracing if possible, 3) include model & seq len in env.txt

sam: FYI I ran a quick local profile and saw a hotspot in `attention_cuda` (kernel: MultiHeadAttention) — will confirm with the nsys trace once downloaded.

cheng: If anyone else runs, please ping here with upload link. We'll run the regression pipeline against baseline commit `e1b2d5` once we have all traces.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
